{{Quote|I hear you are connected to certain individuals not friendly to the Empire.''"<br />"''Is that so? Maybe I am. Maybe I am not. How do I know where your allegiance lies?|A spacer and Garek|<ref name="SWG:HtA" />}}
'''Garek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our spies tell us that the Empire has formed a temporary alliance with the Rak'qua over in Station Gamma. We also think that they may have uncovered the location of our secret base. I need you to get in there and access the databank to find out if they have tracked down our brethren.|Garek, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtDotI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Gathering the Dirt on the Imperials|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] Garek was stationed on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. During that time, he managed a network of Rebel spies collecting information regarding Imperial activity, including [[Rund Jesela]] and [[Adery Shrial]].<ref name="SWG:HtA" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Garek was very concerned about the [[Rak'qua]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] tribe living in [[Station Gamma]], another space station in the Bright Jewel system. Rebels spies suspected that the Rak'qua had formed an alliance with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], allowing Imperials to perform horrible experiments in the station. Garek therefore recruited a group of loyal Rebel spacers to investigate the situation.<ref name="SWG:GtDotI" /> To evaluate his new recruits, Garek first tasked them to retrieve [[Datacard/Legends|datadisks]] with important information from Rebel agents on Tansarii Point Station. Although the datadisks only contained [[Grandma Drake]]'s soup recipes, the spacers achieved their first mission.<ref name="SWG:HtA" /> They were later ordered to proceed to their new objective: the Rak'qua of Station Gamma. The spacers therefore raided the station, killing a number of hostile Rak'qua during the attack, and successfully [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the Station Gamma [[Memory bank/Legends|databank]]. The spacers then returned safely to Tansarii Point Station and delivered the information to Agent Garek.<ref name="SWG:GtDotI" /> Although Rebel spies were right about an alliance existing between the Rak'qua and the Empire, this arrangement had in fact already been broken by the Rak'qua at that time.<ref name="SWG:GIFSG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Get Information From Station Gamma|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Garek appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HtA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Garek was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:HtA" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
